# Awesome AI App Demo Video Workflows

> Open demo-v1 specifications for turning app screenshots and exported UI prototype states into deterministic, reviewable product demo videos.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/HiAPIAI/awesome-ai-app-demo-video-workflows
English overview: README.md
Chinese overview: README.zh-CN.md
Workflow catalog: data/workflows.json
Setup: docs/setup.md
Authoring: docs/authoring.md
Source schema guide: docs/schema-reference.md
Render acceptance matrix: docs/acceptance-matrix.md
HiAPI safety: docs/hiapi-safety.md
Launch assets: docs/launch-kit.md
Source contract: schemas/demo-v1.schema.json
Compiled contract: schemas/compiled-demo-v1.schema.json
Contribution guide: CONTRIBUTING.md
Security policy: SECURITY.md

## Important constraints

- Workflow source uses schemaVersion demo-v1; renderer input uses compiled-demo-v1.
- Rendering consumes compiled JSON and does not independently reinterpret YAML.
- Critical UI, text, cursors, callouts, metrics, and comparison evidence are deterministic local layers.
- HiAPI is optional and may enhance only a background, intro, transition, or outro.
- Paid generation requires explicit approval, current preflight confirmation, idempotency, and a pending journal.
- Examples are spec-only until every complete rendered output passes human review.
- Do not infer that fictional example products or metrics are real customers or measured claims.
- Do not expose credentials, signed URLs, customer screenshots, private prototypes, or generated binaries.
